title: Run source in three stages
description: run_source keeps lexing, parsing, and evaluation in one reusable error-propagating function.

steps.description: The runner imports the lexer, parser, interpreter, environment, and Program types.
run_source receives source and an interpreter. Its docstring names its return value and the three error classes it can propagate.
Stage 1 tokenizes the source and can raise LexError.
Stage 2 builds the program tree and can raise ParseError.
Stage 3 evaluates the tree in the interpreter's global environment and can raise RuntimeError_.
